integrity: Every mathematical claim is supported by the self-contained derivation; finite enumerations are corroborative only. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula holds for uniform recursive trees with independent edge retention; leaves refer to the underlying unpercolated tree. Correlation asymptotics require fixed interior retention probability. Full historical priority and independent audit have not been established.
title: Root-cluster and leaf counts are positively correlated but asymptotically decorrelate in percolated recursive trees
